E01.title: Jensen et al. 2015, BMC Cancer (Denmark). Diagnostic intervals before and after cancer patient pathways: adjusted median diagnostic interval 17 days shorter (95% CI 15–19); outside the pathway 4 days longer (1–7). Before/after.
E01.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E02.title: Abuhasanein et al. 2022, Scand J Urol (Sweden). Bladder cancer standardized care pathways: median referral-to-TURBT 37 -> 27 days. Before/after.
E02.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E03.title: Sørensen et al. 2013, Eur Arch Otorhinolaryngol (Denmark). Head-and-neck fast track with pre-booked slots: referral-to-first-visit 8 -> 1 days; referral-to-diagnosis 24 -> 7–10 days. Single setting, before/after.
E03.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E04.title: Villadsen et al. 2019, J Gastrointestin Liver Dis (Denmark). Hepatocellular cancer fast track: mean referral-to-treatment 53.2 -> 35.9 days; survival difference not significant (p=0.11). n=309, before/after.
E04.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E05.title: Nilssen et al. 2019, Cancer Epidemiology (Norway). Treatment waits fell 2007–2016 but with no significant break at the 2015 pathway implementation. Zero-effect caution.
E05.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E06.title: Borg et al. 2023, Scientific Reports (Sweden). State-transition model of standardized cancer patient pathways; 12/28 pathways met inclusion targets, 5/28 time targets. Design precedent only.
E06.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E07.title: Olsen et al. 2021, BMC Health Serv Res (Norway). Access to cancer patient pathways varied by age and hospital referral area; higher income raised inclusion.
E07.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E08.title: Lynch et al. 2022, Br J Gen Pract. Referral structures in 10 jurisdictions: non-specific-symptom routes, direct diagnostic access. No effect size.
E08.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E09.title: Ridd et al. 2015, Br J Gen Pract. GP continuity: small, inconsistent associations with time to cancer diagnosis.
E09.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E10.title: Jäntti et al. 2021, Eur J Public Health (Finland). Colorectal screening 2004–2016: 31.6% non-participation; about 80% of first-round non-participants missed round two.
E10.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E11.title: Seppänen et al. 2026, J Med Screen (Finland). Cervical screening 2019–2023: participation 50.9% with primary education vs 77.6% with tertiary.
E11.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E12.title: Vives et al. 2024, JMIR Public Health Surveill (Spain, RCT). SMS reminder to FIT-kit non-returners: return at 30 days 64.2% vs 53.7% (+10.5 pp); at 126 days +4.9 pp.
E12.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E13.title: Coronado et al. 2023, Cancer Epidemiol Biomarkers Prev (USA, cluster RCT). Enhanced mailed FIT outreach: six-month completion +2.8 pp (95% CI 0.4–5.2).
E13.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E14.title: Hanna et al. 2020, BMJ (meta-analysis). Each four-week delay of cancer surgery associated with mortality HR about 1.06–1.08. Association, not county-level causal effect.
E14.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E15.title: Tope et al. 2023, eLife (review of reviews). 33 distinct definitions of delay intervals; waiting-time paradox.
E15.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.

E16.title: Vedsted et al. 2022, BMJ Open. Breast cancer pathways in 10 jurisdictions: large variation in patient, primary care, diagnostic and treatment intervals.
E16.note: Published result, not a Finnish county observation. Accessed via Consensus.
